record_policy.raw_JSON_size_limit: 4096 bytes for byte input, 4096 code points for string input; UTF-8 bytes only
record_policy.returned_record: detached frozen dataclass with immutable value/count tuples

count_rule: For valid channel i: round((value-low)/(high-low)*4095), Python ties-to-even; normalized proxy only, no DAC/XADC calibration.

quality_rules.bits_0_3: valid per channel; EM bits 0..2 must be all 0 or all 1
quality_rules.bits_4_7: saturated per channel; requires valid; saturated EM value is an endpoint; vibration RMS may be below endpoint because saturation is window-wide
quality_rules.bits_8_10: EM held iff em_tick_ms < adc_tick_ms; all 3 agree
quality_rules.bit_11: zero; vibration RMS is never an EM held sample
quality_rules.bit_12: source_fault iff EM invalid; current candidate has no other source_fault category
quality_rules.bits_13_15: zero on this raw candidate record; do not map UART grant semantics into it
quality_rules.invalid_EM: em_tick_ms null, all 3 EM channels invalid; real vibration may remain valid
quality_rules.vibration: 10 contiguous observed 10ms ADC records; earliest origin-zero valid tick 90ms; a saturated RMS is at least sqrt(4/10) g

ledger_rules.storage: in-memory single-writer per-run snapshot, no durable journal or automatic restore
ledger_rules.origin: trusted caller binds start_tick_ms to start_monotonic_ns; full producer ADC history starts at that tick
ledger_rules.receiver_clock: nonnegative integer nanoseconds, same domain as origin; healthy/accept/accept_json share a high-water mark initialized to origin; every valid nondecreasing clock argument is observed before untrusted payload parsing/validation; equality allowed
ledger_rules.clock_high_water_ns: read-only diagnostic separate from the sample snapshot; valid trusted clocks advance even if payload/JSON is rejected; invalid or backward clock inputs raise ValueError and do not change it
ledger_rules.ADC: strictly increasing 10ms-grid tick; duplicates/reverse/backfill rejected; first tick equals origin
ledger_rules.EM: 50ms-grid tick not later than ADC, age <=100ms; a new EM timestamp must equal this record's ADC tick; no late introduction of a missed acquisition
ledger_rules.hold: numeric EM values, counts and saturation unchanged while em_tick_ms unchanged; never increments native EM count
ledger_rules.invalidated_hold: after source_fault, old EM cannot revive; later new valid acquisition in its own ADC slot required
ledger_rules.ADC_gap: no fabricated rows; contiguous vibration count resets to one; claimed vibration validity must exactly match observed history
ledger_rules.arrival: origin-mapped ADC and EM timestamps must each be <= receipt and no older than 100ms
ledger_rules.rejection: ValueError, no sample admission/EM count/heartbeat/snapshot mutation; a valid nondecreasing trusted clock argument remains observed even on rejection
ledger_rules.source_fault_record: admit explicit invalid state but do not update last_healthy_received_ns; healthy() immediately false
ledger_rules.heartbeat: healthy first observes the shared clock high-water mark without changing sample/heartbeat records; valid EM and receipt age and original EM age each <=100ms required; expired strictly above 100ms; an earlier subsequent query/admission clock raises instead of reviving health
ledger_rules.health_diagnostic: last_healthy_received_ns is valid EM ingress time, including legitimate hold; it never replaces original EM deadline
ledger_rules.run_reset: new externally authorized run/channel binding only; no automatic reset or fault clearing

unimplemented: authenticated process transport, ACLs and run/epoch binding
trusted clock acquisition, clock error/drift bounds and runtime scheduler measurement
attestation that producer really acquired instead of forging plausible values and ticks
hardware sending, DAC, XADC, PL, RS485, FPGA observations and controls
independent FDEM validation, sensor calibration and physical performance
